$description: Where each token in src/tokens.ts came from. Keyed by leaf path (the path inside shared, themes.light|dark or profiles.web|desktop|mobile, so a colour in both themes and a size on every platform are one entry). source: the product's Tier 2 name (--fg-body); mobile:<path> for a token in the phone's tokens.ts; proposal; or unmapped. mobile: the phone's own token for the mobile profile or palette when it differs from source. The source of a profile leaf is the desktop's; the web profile is a proposal for every leaf. Drafted by apps/catalogue/scripts/tokens-map.mts and hand-checked; drift against the product is printed by tokens-map.mts --drift.
